newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Montreal cuts loan loss provisions.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Montreal cuts loan loss provisions.

text.p: Bank of Montreal said on Tuesday that it cut its loan loss provisions to C$225 million in 1996 from a year-ago C$275 million due to "superior credit performance."
Canada's third largest bank said net impaired loans totalling C$489 million at July 31 fell by C$225 million from the last quarter and by C$346 million since October 31, 1995.
A third quarter review said the bank would not need more than C$225 million in provisions for fiscal 1996.
Also, "the general provision was increased to C$475 million by a transfer of excess reserves from LDC (less developed countries) provisions no longer needed," it said.
